title: Keel Agent (keel/v1alpha1)
description: kind: Agent — a logical responsibility routed by Keel to a governed ModelExecutor, possibly a different provider than the parent session.

role.description: audit/review return findings without writing (section 14.10 auditor mode).

match.description: Declarative routing (D-014): when this agent applies to a prompt. Optional — the compiler derives terms from id+objective; `match` augments/refines.

terms.description: Explicit alias words/phrases (weighted above derived terms) that route to this agent.

context.description: Structured object types this agent applies to, e.g. github_pr, linear_ticket.

autoload.description: Opt-in: on a high-confidence match, surface this agent as a strong suggestion. Default false.

outputSchema.description: Path (workspace-relative) to the JSON Schema the AgentResult is validated against (invariant 12).
